title: Code 3 TCG — prioritized 250 improvements
bestBuy: Paused; no inventory polling or alert activation authorized
disclaimer: Original suggestions are synthetic planning prompts, not real member findings. Ranking is product judgment based on the current code audit, not a statistical score or a delivery-date promise.
method: First: audited join/recovery, privacy, feedback and first-task gaps. Next: data resilience and report/notification trust. Then: workflow refinements. Original IMP identifiers and wording remain unchanged.
